test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: No humans are immortal. Some humans are scientists. Which of the following conclusions can be made ?
solution:
Given Statements:

No humans are immortal.

Some humans are scientists.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3174de426b3bd53403e58d00c49b2d7522169e5d3f5f715abcd9f941b0889173.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All humans are immortal. → **False** (This directly contradicts the first statement, "No humans are immortal.")

II. All scientists are mortal. → **False** (The statements do not provide enough information to definitively conclude that all scientists are mortal. So we do not say that "All scientists are mortal".)

III. Some scientists are not immortal. → **True** (Since "No humans are immortal" and "Some humans are scientists," it logically follows that the group of scientists who are humans must not be immortal. This is a definite conclusion.)

IV. Some scientists are not humans. → **False** (The statements only confirm that some scientists are humans, not that any are non-human. This conclusion cannot be drawn.)

**So, only conclusion III follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 3".**
